00022 /* We will run out of memory if we track (create HxApplication records
00023  * for) an unlimited number of apps, and having run out will be unable
00024  * to launch any of them.  So better to limit the amount of shared
00025  * memory we commit to tracking installed apps.  Since the launcher is
00026  * currently hardcoded to display no more than 210 apps we might as
00027  * well cap the number we'll track there as well.  */
